messages:
leon: Quick question — while reviewing the Ruby SDK sampleapp PR I noticed behavior parity gap vs Go client for retries on 429s. In Ruby we backoff then raise, Go will treat 429 as retryable by default. Anyone recall the rationale?

nora: We historically kept retry policies conservative in Ruby to avoid surprising long-running requests for sync users. But we added env opts to opt-in. Which PR is this?

leon: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/118 — the change adds an automatic retry middleware on top of httpx with jitter/backoff. Tests fail in CI intermittently with timeout on streaming specs.

ash: Hmm, streaming + automatic retry can double-deliver if the SDK retries mid-stream. Go's client treats streaming differently and disables body-retries. Maybe the PR enables retries globally.

leon: Right — here's the key part of the change:```ruby
# sampleapp/middleware/retry.rb
class RetryMiddleware
  def call(req)
    attempts = 0
    begin
      attempts += 1
      resp = @app.call(req)
      raise RetryableError if resp.status == 429 && attempts < 3
      resp
    rescue RetryableError
      sleep(0.1 * attempts)
      retry
    end
  end
end
```

nora: That will retry for streamed endpoints too. We need a guard to skip when req.stream? or explicitly only retry for simple request/response operations (embeddings, chat non-streaming).

ash: Agreed. For parity we should: 1) adopt Go semantics: no automatic body retries for streaming, 2) provide an opt-in global retry policy via RB_RETRY_MODE=permissive, 3) update sampleapp README to call out behavior.

devx-bot: CI note: lint/format errors in the PR. Run `bundle exec rubocop -a` to fix.

leon: Also saw a flake in rspec: `spec/streaming_integration_spec.rb` times out only on single-node macOS matrix; adding a short-circuit to disable network retries fixes it locally. But that's not acceptable for tests.

nora: For tests we should stub network or inject a test-only retry policy. Could add a helper that sets `REDWOOD_RETRY_STRATEGY=test_stub` in CI matrix.

ash: Another quick fix is to make retry middleware check `if req.options[:stream]` or `req.headers['x-stream'] == '1'` and skip. That preserves behavior and keeps tests green.

leon: I'll open a follow-up commit implementing stream guard and add ENV opt. Will also add a unit test ensuring middleware is a no-op for streaming requests.

ci-bot: github/actions - ruby-sampleapp CI #1124 started by leon - jobs: unit, integration (macos-arm), lint

nora: For release notes, mark this as "behavioral change (retry) - opt-in for permissive mode" so users upgrading know. Also add migration note to CHANGELOG.

leon: Thanks — pinging @ash for PR review once I push. Also adding a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about avoiding retries for streams when writing middlewares.

ash: Will review. If tests pass we can merge and cut 0.7.0-pre patch for qa branch.

leon: Sweet. Appreciate the quick eyes :slightly_smiling_face:
